note: Static question templates for the highest-leverage-gap signal (EnrichmentEngine). This is a LOCAL heuristic substitute for the Build Brief §5.5 'silent meta-call' LLM pass — no on-device LLM is available, so instead of asking a model 'what 3 context items would most change your response', the engine ranks its own already-detected gap.detected signals and surfaces one static question per gap type. No raw prompt text is ever involved; the id/question pair is public, non-sensitive copy.
